literal: Speak, in speech, words possessing usefulness; do not speak, in speech, words lacking usefulness.
translation: If you speak, speak only words that have usefulness; do not speak words that are devoid of any benefit.
modern: பேசினால் பயனுள்ள வார்த்தைகளைப் பேசுங்கள்; பயனில்லாத வார்த்தைகளைப் பேசாதீர்கள்.
explanation: This couplet concludes the chapter on avoiding useless talk with a direct and memorable command. The author advises that if one must speak, they should choose only those words that carry meaning, benefit, or utility. Conversely, one must completely avoid uttering words that are empty and yield no positive outcome. By repeating the structure of speaking and not speaking, the verse emphasizes that speech is a tool to be used purposefully, and silence is far superior to useless chatter.
